title: Separate classical specification acquisition from quantum execution
statement: The classical program derives exact heat-bath rates,threshold colors,two-slot inverse-fibre rational columns,conditional reference messages,pi_min/partition and requested sparse parity means from supplied positive rational factors,without enumerating2^n states per acquisition/column. It does not infer unknown factors,generate quantum rotations or execute the consumer. Finite-bit rotation trees and reversible erasure give paper W/W-dagger with uniform operator error using disjoint supports,not a sqrt(2^n) basis-error conversion. Complexity is polynomial in n,2^k,input bits,log(1/error),with actual m paid. The n64 symbolic example has380 colors,R324808/4641,kappa8399/9282,m6111 and67077-byte specification;reported tests include malformed/tampered records,n64/n128 symbolic cases and exact small chains. kappa<=0 gives valid data but RETURN NOT ADMITTED;writing huge m in binary does not make executing it cheap.

requires: Known strictly positive rational chain factors/known local contexts and bounded width k;actual influence-column contraction kappa>0 for threshold return admission.
Prepared sqrt(pi),acquired coherent W/W-dagger/color state and source-diagonal controls with separately budgeted finite errors;final classical source is obtained by basis dephasing/measurement.
Controlled classical equivalence requires adjoints preserving the source-diagonal system-operator algebra;private artificial jump colors/arbitrary source coherence are excluded.

Later direct-generator proof/code/receipts are unavailable in this delivered cut;billions of padded kernel stages for four spins are a visible conservative cost notice,not an attached audited implementation or practical advantage.
